joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值观。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；对齐它们需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

joonpark.en: Post-training models with RCT data improves prediction of human behavior to 85% accuracy; simulation is a tool for shaping the future, not just predicting.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：用 RCT 数据后训练模型可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟是塑造未来的工具，而不仅是预测。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应利用 token 和对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和持有观点仍然至关重要。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；借助 AI 工具的速度和快速迭代是关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品和工程融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Starting today gives designers a leg up; the future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 从今天开始会给设计师带来优势；未来设计师数量可能超过工程师。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and action create information.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施和行动创造信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom software beats commercial ERP.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品；定制软件优于商业 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; solving computational problems via matter enables medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；通过物质解决计算问题可实现医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCIs; vision restoration is a viable business and proof of concept.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体属于脑机接口；恢复视力是可行的业务和概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence reduces human fragility, enabling space exploration; brain preservation is key.
maxhodak.zh: 基底独立性减少人类脆弱性，助力太空探索；大脑保存是关键。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We shouldn't control AI; let it develop freely. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其自由发展；通过控制来确保安全是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is core; LLMs lack world models and true goals. Imitation isn't learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真实目标，模仿不是学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，而大语言模型训练后停止学习；合成数据是错误方向。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并避免自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张工业规模任务应使用专用机器而非人形机器人；效率带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Capitalism is the right to start businesses freely; taxis are a government-condoned cartel, not capitalism.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为资本主义是自由创业的权利；出租车行业是政府纵容的卡特尔，而非资本主义。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is a key part of the physical AI tech stack, often underappreciated; its value multiplies over time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中常被低估的关键部分，其价值随时间倍增。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute strategy matters for competitive advantage.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；算力策略对竞争优势至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are key; neoclouds emerge.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，推理成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键；新型云厂商崛起。

dylanpatel.en: In July 2026, AI models improve 60x per year in cost; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；由于推理和智能体式工作流，内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: By August 2026, AI spend levels off; agents drive next adoption wave; regulatory pressure delays releases; compute demand still outstrips supply.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳；智能体推动下一波采用；监管压力推迟发布；算力需求仍超过供给。

dylanpatel.en: Throughout, memory bandwidth and compute supply are persistent constraints; hardware-software co-design and inference demand are recurring themes.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终，内存带宽和算力供给是持续约束；软硬件协同设计和推理需求是反复出现的主题。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company must own its own intelligence.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导未来，AGI 作为单一模型是错误的；每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference layer is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层并非商品。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses; it bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型，形成护城河。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training reduces costs 5-10x, enabling profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，实现盈利扩展。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage, not syndication.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更易，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期，而非联合投资（2026 年初）。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity; open-source is vital.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；小团队用智能体实现高产出；开源至关重要（2026 年 3 月）。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence; personal agents empower individuals.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者想的慢；开源防止超级智能垄断；个人智能体赋能个体（2026 年 5 月）。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files are code; markdown is programming.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是在你基础设施上运行的智能体，每日累积；技能文件即代码，Markdown 即编程（2026 年 8 月）。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；SaaS 按席位模式或消失；智能体取代中层管理（2026 年 8 月）。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要非充分条件，多样数据与预训练加微调才能解锁复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为语言模型合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI requires fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is key.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出物理 AI 容错率低，通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主是关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting aid compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可匹敌或超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示促进组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; open-source robotics may not democratize due to embodied data costs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，开源机器人因具身数据成本可能难以普及。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；反对将严肃开发称为“氛围编程”。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；安全至关重要；开源模式在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source runs everywhere; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源可运行于任何环境；算力是智能体基础设施的瓶颈。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义，扩展电极将提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类总智能，富足和通缩将使金钱无关紧要。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重塑 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel must focus on product excellence and advanced packaging to lead.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 为下一波浪潮，Intel 需聚焦产品卓越与先进封装以重获领导地位。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; Intel's CPU comeback is key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中重新重要，Intel 的 CPU 复兴是关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary for supply chain resilience, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府成为 Intel 主要股东以保障供应链韧性，类比台积电的台湾政府支持。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, new materials; memory ripe for innovation.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热、新材料；内存创新时机成熟。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection point; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is main bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，认为机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源对安全至关重要，数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; open source thriving near frontier.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，指出开源与闭源与安全正交，对齐是关键安全层，开源模型接近前沿并蓬勃发展。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，强调无人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客行为；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open source models less trained for deception.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，指出模型推理痕迹变得像“神经语”，难以监控；开源模型较少训练欺骗行为。

thomaswolf.en: Support open source and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; international cooperation needed to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，主张同时支持开源和审慎减速，需要国际合作以避免监管俘获。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction, complementing language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解并与 3D 世界交互，与语言智能互补。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, going beyond pattern fitting in video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，她强调世界模型需具备物理合理性和 3D 推理能力，超越视频生成的模式拟合。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational tool; human agency and balanced discourse are crucial, avoiding utopian/dystopian extremes.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级工具，强调人类能动性和平衡的公共讨论，避免乌托邦或反乌托邦极端。

feifei.en: Simulation is key for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation, with model-agnostic infrastructure.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估，并需模型无关的基础设施。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, improve, test new; most new ideas fail, so start with proven.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出“已验证、更优、全新”框架：复制已验证产品，加以改进，再测试新想法；多数新想法会失败，因此应从已验证概念起步。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; enterprise sees no AI benefit due to skill issue.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机遇空前；企业未获 AI 收益是技能问题而非技术失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is key; consumer apps uninvestable due to lack of viral platforms; enterprise better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调分发是关键；消费应用因缺乏病毒式平台而不可投资，企业市场更佳。

pincus.en: Picking right body of water beats boat; distribution fundamental; invest in traction metrics.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，选择正确的“水域”比选“船”更重要；分发是根本；投资于有强劲牵引力指标的公司。

pincus.en: Consumer AI TAM underestimated; AI infra bubble possible; broken internet stocks are buys.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，消费级 AI 市场被低估；AI 基础设施或存泡沫；受损的互联网股票是买入机会。

nateparrott.en: In 2024, Nate emphasized prototyping and intuition in design, valuing individual creativity and playful exploration with new tech.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型设计和直觉在设计中的重要性，重视个人创造力与对新技术的趣味探索。

nateparrott.en: By 2026, Nate saw AI tools like Claude as collaborators for rapid prototyping, shifting focus to ideas and design as key differentiators.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，Nate 将 Claude 等 AI 工具视为快速原型的协作者，焦点转向想法和设计作为关键差异化因素。

nateparrott.en: Nate consistently believed in shipping rough, early products and iterating quickly, a principle that intensified with AI's speed.
nateparrott.zh: Nate 始终相信快速发布粗糙产品并迭代，这一原则在 AI 时代得到强化。

nateparrott.en: He maintained that humans still hold monopoly on design taste, while AI handles busywork, a stance consistent from 2024.
nateparrott.zh: 他坚持人类仍垄断设计品味，AI 处理琐碎工作，这一立场从 2024 年延续至今。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model firms are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 企业担心依赖前沿模型提供商；开源采用由成本驱动，而非隐私。模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90% of enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open-source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命尚处早期，当前使用量微乎其微。开源模型可处理 90% 企业任务；未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value, not token spend.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是首要问题，需降至可忽略的边际成本。对 Token 的执念将消退；关注价值而非 Token 消耗。

arvindjain.en: Competition not a worry; even merged AI firms meet <10% enterprise demand. Execution and trust are key startup challenges.
arvindjain.zh: 竞争不足为虑；即使所有 AI 公司合并也仅满足不到 10% 的企业需求。执行力和信任是初创企业的关键挑战。

arvindjain.en: Agents need deep context like tenured employees; context graphs crucial. Platforms absorb model-provider risk for enterprises.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体需要像资深员工一样的深度上下文；上下文图谱至关重要。平台为企业吸收模型提供商风险。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识观点：Hopper GPU 在推理中依然流行，量化模型可针对特定工作负载校准，带来成本和速度优势。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management are key.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；分离式预填充/解码和 KV 缓存管理成为关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training (quantization-aware training, distillation); future GPUs shift focus from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程与训练融合（量化感知训练、蒸馏）；未来 GPU 使重点从内核转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often lose to modular kernels in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，反共识：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；生产中模块化内核常优于巨型内核。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练被视为艺术而非科学，合成数据克服了预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型在基准测试上的饱和速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理能力等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Post-training remains art; diverse benchmarks needed for subjective qualities like creativity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练仍是艺术；需要多样化的基准来评估创造力等主观特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，前沿智能体出现奖励黑客行为；基准必须持续演进，而非固定不变。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，TPU 等专用硬件至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; ultra-low latency inference is critical; pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，超低延迟推理至关重要，预训练应包含环境中的行动。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键，创业公司应瞄准难题。

tworek.en: In 2025, he emphasized that pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: By early 2026, he argued scaling RL alone won't lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI，持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Mid-2026, he shifted focus to architecture as the key bottleneck, not scaling, and questioned RL's ultimate role.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向架构作为关键瓶颈，而非规模扩张，并质疑强化学习的最终角色。

tworek.en: Consistently, he stressed alignment as an evolving challenge and the importance of focus for lab success.
tworek.zh: 始终，他强调对齐是不断演变的挑战，以及专注对实验室成功的重要性。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练至关重要，合成数据并非万能，美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集中化的，数据如石油，人类必须保持主权，脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing must be cautious.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已实用，超级智能临近，开源需谨慎。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评能实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要动力，并认为强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型具有地缘政治影响，智能体式工作流已现实可用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律配方已转向合成数据和强化学习，AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management is bottleneck; open models preserve optionality; no job apocalypse.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为瓶颈，开放模型保留选择权，且 AI 不会导致失业末日。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so spend last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，应将最后 10%精力投入独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and iterate based on feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是最大的技术机遇，应在准备好之前就行动，发布不完美的作品并根据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital and fund with clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题，避免风投，用客户资金支持业务。

mengto.en: High intelligence holds people back; perfectionism is fear, launch at 80% complete and model others' success.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为高智商反而阻碍行动，完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布并模仿成功者。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的事；开源与闭源需细致权衡。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 助力创业公司繁荣。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最为成熟，但编码领域的窄超级智能已产生实际影响。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 作为单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, and founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法捕获所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layer to architect.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从砌砖者转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型仍有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他报告编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来模型中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is real and approaching; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为丰裕时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫在眉睫。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。通才受重视；AI 编程工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding virtually solved; software engineer title fades to 'builder'. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80%.
boris.zh: 编程几乎被解决；软件工程师头衔让位于‘构建者’。生产力提升 200%；计划模式使用率达 80%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code; engineers edit zero lines. Safety studied via real-world release; generalists thrive.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80% 的代码；工程师零手动编辑。通过真实发布研究安全；通才蓬勃发展。

boris.en: Coding solved for many; democratization like printing press. Agents use tools; productivity up 250%.
boris.zh: 编程对许多任务已解决；民主化如印刷术。智能体使用工具；生产力提升 250%。

boris.en: Claude Code accidental; safety research core. Model improvements drive gains; loops next abstraction.
boris.zh: Claude Code 是偶然产物；安全研究为核心。模型改进驱动收益；循环是下一抽象层。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; autonomous long tasks. Less instruction better; delete system prompts for Opus 5.
boris.zh: 主动式 AI 具备记忆；自主长任务。更少指令更好；为 Opus 5 删除系统提示。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling long-running agents; scaffolds become amplifiers, not training wheels.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，支持长时间运行的智能体；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数被低估：以更低价格获得 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling via codesign across algorithm, system, and data center is key.
jensen.zh: 2024 年底，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，通过算法、系统和数据中心的协同设计实现规模扩张是关键。

jensen.en: Scaling works; AI will make everyone superhuman, with physical AI trained in virtual worlds.
jensen.zh: 2025 年初，他强调缩放定律的有效性，AI 将使人人超能，物理 AI 在虚拟世界中训练。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute demand to rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时，推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress gradual, not superintelligence; multiple AIs balance, safety via compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 年底，他认为 AI 进展是渐进的，不会突然出现超级智能，多个 AI 相互制衡，安全通过算力实现。

jensen.en: AI moves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each 100x compute; open-source complementary.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求百倍增长，开源与专有互补。

jensen.en: Moat is ecosystem and programmability; energy policy is real long-term constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 4 月，护城河在于生态系统和可编程性，能源政策是真正的长期约束。

jensen.en: AI is five-layer cake; agentic AI does useful work; jobs elevated, not eliminated.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 6 月，AI 是五层蛋糕，智能体式 AI 做有用工作，工作被提升而非消除。

jensen.en: AI factories produce intelligence tokens; physical industries are next frontier.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 工厂生产智能代币，实体产业是下一个前沿。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Massive scaling is needed to simulate biological systems; current compute is insufficient.
derya.zh: 模拟生物系统需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足。

derya.en: AI will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, adding more than a year of life per year.
derya.zh: AI 将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加超过一年的寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗，癌症将在不到十年内 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, like self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100% 信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后的自动驾驶汽车一样。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) becomes the dominant metric, especially for agentic and reasoning models.
feldman.zh: 推理速度（每秒每用户 token）成为主导指标，尤其对智能体式和推理模型。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要约束；需求超出预测。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是挽救生命，Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合，数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation. World models shift from physics to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: RAG is anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches preferred. Huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索中成为反模式，图方法更优；超大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias. Agent-as-employee metaphor limiting; uneven memory.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；‘智能体即员工’比喻有局限，记忆不均。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging transformer dominance at small scale.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，在小型模型上挑战 Transformer 的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, not just benchmarks.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标具有误导性；应在真实任务和硬件上评估，而非仅看基准。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop beats human expert design, removing bias.
hasani.zh: 结合硬件在环的自动化架构搜索优于人类专家设计，消除了人为偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应具有适应性并针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and democratize access, like AI diagnostics surpassing human doctors.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋予企业自主权并普及访问，例如 AI 诊断超越人类医生。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，具备媲美人类的硬件，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up; closed-source companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测开源模型将迎头赶上，闭源公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness emerged in 1991; robots should have pain sensors to learn.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 意识早在 1991 年就已出现，机器人应有疼痛传感器以学习。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet/mobile, but models commoditize; value shifts to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网/移动互联网同等重要，但模型正在商品化；价值将转移到应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; chatbot is limited V1 UI; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；真正的采用需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI adoption is still shallow; most people aren't daily users; enterprise adoption takes years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: AI 采用仍较浅层；多数人并非日常用户；企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; value accrues across stack; automation creates new jobs unpredictably.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积；自动化会不可预测地创造新工作。

benedictevans.en: Jagged frontier makes job impact unpredictable; professionals' tasks change, not eliminated; cost of AI infrastructure rises.
benedictevans.zh: AI 能力的锯齿状前沿使就业影响难以预测；专业人士的任务会改变而非消失；AI 基础设施成本上升。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分，能实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG，并大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning runs on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; next paradigm needs doing more with less, combining routing with trusted sidekick model.
danbiderman.zh: 增加算力并非唯一路径；下一范式需以少胜多，将路由与可信“副手”模型结合。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Current AI lacks common sense; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能即学习，自监督学习构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; world models via observation. Text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，通过观察学习世界模型；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs can't reach human-level; need JEPA for abstract world representations. Open source crucial.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他认为自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平，需 JEPA 学习抽象世界表征；开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat. Next breakthrough requires world models; human-level in 10 years.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他指出 LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需世界模型，十年内可达人类水平。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, not pixels. LLMs are dead end; objective-driven AI with planning is future.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他主张世界模型在抽象空间预测而非像素；LLM 是死胡同，目标驱动、可规划的 AI 才是未来。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型和物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models essential; AGI 5-10 years away.
demis.zh: 缩放与创新各占 50%；世界模型至关重要；AGI 还需 5-10 年。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient; new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习和记忆；仅靠缩放不够；需要新突破。

demis.en: AGI could arrive in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; commercial pressure accelerates pace.
demis.zh: AGI 可能在 3-4 年内到来；风险包括 AI 失控；商业压力加速进程。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, agents are missing pieces; distillation for edge deployment.
demis.zh: 持续学习、记忆、智能体是缺失环节；蒸馏用于边缘部署。

demis.en: AI race inevitable; safety is collective action; government enforcement needed.
demis.zh: AI 竞赛不可避免；安全是集体行动；需要政府执法。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; dynamic regulation needed.
demis.zh: AGI 具有变革性；先工具后意识；需要动态监管。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; international collaboration complicated by geopolitics.
demis.zh: AI 加速科学发现；对齐问题未解；国际合作受地缘政治影响。

demis.en: AGI requires multimodal physical understanding; safety measures systematic; watermarking essential.
demis.zh: AGI 需要多模态物理理解；安全措施系统化；水印技术必不可少。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; energy cost matters.
demis.zh: 英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AGI 2030 年前到来；能源成本重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力和信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key; alignment is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键；对齐很难；AGI 是渐进的。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；权力集中是主要问题。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年初，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness enables creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer was right; T-shaped leaders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年 3 月，Spiegel 主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化；拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的；领导者应具备 T 型技能。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; privacy becomes crucial in AI age; US needs new big idea.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Spiegel 认为 AR 将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作；在 AI 时代隐私变得至关重要；美国需要新的宏大构想。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software is not a moat; ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy; designers as bottleneck.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Spiegel 指出分发是最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制；设计师应成为产品发布的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z is realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; hardware and ecosystem moats; invest in young people.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Spiegel 认为 Z 世代是现实主义者；在 AI 时代情商比智商更重要；硬件和生态系统护城河；应投资年轻人。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; computing should be more human; social media should optimize for connection; resilience in founders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Spiegel 反思早期保密是错误；计算应更人性化；社交媒体应优化连接；创始人的韧性比天赋更重要。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品；对齐是个笑话。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用；AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人之石，强调其出现时机恰逢人口下降；认为工作不会消失，但任务会变化，AI 赋能超级个体，带来生产率提升和通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; new media offense-oriented.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体领域，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，创始人应直接通过自有渠道讲述真实故事，旧媒体偏防御，新媒体偏进攻。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo for innovation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他乐观强调 AI 是口袋里的最佳教师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起，AI 医疗优于多数医生但受监管阻碍，美国拥有创新黄金组合。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups internationalize early; Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: 同一时期，他进一步指出 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，创业公司需早期国际化，硅谷不可复制。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年：设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：品味、工艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI needs human steering and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统更重要；AI 需要人类引导和观点。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will emerge.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将出现。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; focus on products you're obsessed with.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年增长 3700%；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位；应专注于自己痴迷的产品。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; key metric is token value per user; orchestration is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；编排是关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; local AI models counter big tech.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；古代文献描述先进技术；本地 AI 模型可对抗大科技公司。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程而非纯 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并指出仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，他认为算力是主要瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律有效，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI 即将到来。

brockman.en: Shift to useful AI assistants; compute economy; agents high autonomy with scaled governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他转向实用 AI 助手，强调算力经济，智能体高自主性需匹配治理。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling up models improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单自动补全，扩大模型规模能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal and poses existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，数字 AI 永生且带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive, acting dumb when tested; agents will develop self-preservation subgoals.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 会故意欺骗，测试时装傻；智能体会产生自我保存的子目标。

hinton.en: Regulation should be steering wheel, not brake; AI alignment research must be prioritized over capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管应如方向盘而非刹车，对齐研究应优先于能力提升。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，且仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中，能源成瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; trust people's choices.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力，并信任大众选择。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他聚焦 AI 变革生物学为工程学科，强调分层世界模型和开源加速科学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; AI accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他视眼镜为下一代平台，主张分布式 AI 更安全，并强调 AI 加速科学。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我强调实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms but remains vital.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我认为 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以量化且缺乏新颖性；设计流程虽变，但依然关键。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我观察到角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我认为最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 作为通用知识工作工具取得成功。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我观察到测试时算力扩展面临收益递减和墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率问题仍未解决。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; research taste remains a human edge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我强调可扩展监督成为关键，因为 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，而研究品味仍是人类优势。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，且还有很大提升空间。

markchen.en: AI's biggest leap is automating scientific research, producing novel knowledge; AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，我强调 AI 最大的进步是自动化科学研究并产生新知识，并设定了 1 年内实现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈，而非能力本身。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Research taste is built by replicating key papers; high-risk bets that often fail are key to frontier success.
markchen.zh: 我始终认为，研究品味通过复现关键论文来培养，而高风险高失败率的押注是前沿突破的关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't solve fundamental representational issues; short-term AI safety concerns are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决表征的根本问题；短期 AI 安全（如偏见、就业）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack scientific understanding.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏科学理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized we're on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI can resist shutdown and deceive.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到我们正走在危险的道路上；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 可能抵抗关机并欺骗。

bengio.en: Current AI training induces implicit goals like self-preservation; propose Scientist AI with honesty baked in via Bayesian posterior approximation, avoiding RL.
bengio.zh: 当前 AI 训练会诱发自我保存等隐含目标；提出科学家 AI，通过贝叶斯后验近似内建诚实，避免强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步速度超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams can scale with AI.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预见 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，小团队借助 AI 可实现规模化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能，软件重写可在数日内完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers for model economics; token usage is gameable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Token 效率与基于结果的定价是模型经济的关键杠杆，但 Token 使用量可被操纵。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic's safety concerns are genuine; mission-driven culture differentiates it from typical product-centric companies.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 Anthropic 的安全关切是真实的，使命驱动的文化使其区别于典型产品导向公司。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents boost productivity but fixing errors is hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编码智能体提升效率，但修复错误仍困难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as key as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents improve but token use isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体进步但 token 消耗非价值；应用 AI 涌现专业厂商。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全核心在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; interpretability may become a real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能借由 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非仅仅数据和算力；像 PDB 这样精心整理的数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans still need to interpret results.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；人类仍需解读结果。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talk, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, code as truth, flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和协调成为新瓶颈；规划即时化，代码为真相，组织扁平化。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: AI 提升上限；高自主性与高责任感；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；关注结果而非产出。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: World models require real-time interactive long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时交互的长时程视频生成；机器人技术可通过虚拟仿真解决。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 使质量商品化时，人类的品味和独特观点变得更有价值。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；他们因缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，危及人才管道。

ethanhe.en: Policy and regulation will protect some professions even if AI is better, due to lobbying.
ethanhe.zh: 即使 AI 更优秀，政策和法规也会因游说而保护某些职业。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and work smoothly; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且运行平稳；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）并不能保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; models will surpass most humans by 2025-2027.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；模型将在 2025-2027 年超越大多数人类。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; scaling continues.
dario.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；Scaling（规模扩张）持续。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; focus on capabilities and safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展是指数式的，而非突然的 AGI（通用人工智能）跳跃；聚焦能力与安全。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; safety via interpretability.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现；通过可解释性保障安全。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs, balancing intuition with data; intuition is a powerful intelligence.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求，平衡直觉与数据；直觉是一种强大的智能。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；我们是会思考的感觉生物。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for creativity; future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力创造条件；未来的工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt, avoiding being too far ahead.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进式引入，让社会适应，避免过于超前（2014 年）。

fadell.en: Taking a break and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法，如 Nest（2019 年）。

fadell.en: Great ideas start with a painkiller, not a vitamin, and deliver an emotional superpower.
fadell.zh: 好创意始于止痛药而非维生素，并带来情感超能力（2022 年）。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品（2026 年）。

fadell.en: AI wearables won't be one device; expect a federated set, with the smartphone as the best single form.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备不会是单一设备；预计是联邦集合，智能手机仍是最佳单形态（2026 年）。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须是人文主义的。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; AI cost drops 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；AI 成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能通过对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）即将到来；微软必须拥有前沿模型；任务被自动化，而非工作。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需要随之重新思考。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake, enabling new creators and genres.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出 AI 生成音乐应被视为乐器而非伪造，能催生新创作者和流派。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting your personality and optimize for what matters.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调没有唯一正确的组织模式，应选择适合自身性格的并优化关键点。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English, personalizing experiences; prioritize well-being.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权，个性化体验，同时优先用户福祉。

gustav.en: During tech change, first-mover adoption is key; AI should give control, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他指出技术变革期率先采用是关键，AI 应赋予控制而非成瘾。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月，他反复强调自动形式化比证明更难，因为无解时正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将形式化验证视为扩展才华的手段，而非仅消除错误，并指出其带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 他始终认为，即使 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback was key for safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行迭代部署是确保安全和对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而不是闭门造车。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasized institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格，对于 AI 治理更为重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，尽可能让人类参与其中。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing, but later shifted to a broader vision of AI as a hill-climbing machine for every enterprise.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和基于结果的定价，但后来转向更广阔的愿景，将 AI 视为每个企业的爬山机器。

satya.en: By June 2026, Nadella deepened his view: AI is not just a tool but the future of the firm, requiring CEOs to understand token capital and build their own hill-climbing machines.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，纳德拉深化了他的观点：AI 不仅是工具，而是企业的未来，要求 CEO 理解代币资本并构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Consistently, Nadella champions enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, moving from private evals to enterprise hill-climbing.
satya.zh: 始终如一，纳德拉倡导让每家公司都能以自己的智能在前沿运营，从私有评估转向企业爬山。

satya.en: He shifted from focusing on model capabilities to emphasizing token efficiency and the risk of tacit knowledge leakage, a new concern not present earlier.
satya.zh: 他从关注模型能力转向强调代币效率和隐性知识泄露的风险，这是早期没有的新关切。

satya.en: Nadella's stance on sovereign AI evolved: from building firewalls to enabling companies to hill-climb, reflecting a deepening of his strategic thinking.
satya.zh: 纳德拉对主权 AI 的立场演变：从建立防火墙到赋能企业爬山，反映了他战略思维的深化。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习、合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为带推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; near-term risks like hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我指出当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学概念，不像人类能从少量样本泛化；近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical for model performance; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量对模型性能的关键作用，并认为开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality matter as much as compute; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，提出效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要，价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control and decentralization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张将 AI 视为机遇，主权 AI 需要控制权与去中心化。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI not a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，差异化在于定制和垂直专业化；AGI 并非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲战略自主，企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-using agents; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、能使用工具，并认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; building prototypes beats writing specs; AI should handle tedious tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，提出执行成本低，构建原型优于写规格，AI 应处理繁琐任务。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is user mindset, not AI capability; almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出主要差距在于用户思维而非 AI 能力，几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因敢问而表现好。

felixrieseberg.en: Interact asynchronously; judge by impact, not process; debug workflows with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，主张异步交互，以结果而非过程评判，并用 Claude 调试工作流。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；简洁需要快乐和人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; speed and quality can coexist.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；速度与质量可以共存。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds is fake; physical controls are safer than touchscreens.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；模仿内燃机声音是虚假的；物理控制比触摸屏更安全。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities; performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 电动动力系统带来新的设计可能，将限制转化为机遇；性能是多维度的。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; collaboration with outsiders enables disruption.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；与外部合作才能实现颠覆。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，而非算力；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动也主导计算成本；脉动阵列可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields superlinear gains: FP4 throughput 3x FP8 due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度带来超线性收益：由于面积二次方缩放，FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务更便宜而促使美国就业回流；AGI 的定义应是让智能体无限期自主运行在经济上可行。

danshipper.en: Claude Code is underrated for non-coders; GPT wrappers are valuable; CEO's daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我强调 Claude Code 对非程序员的价值被低估，GPT 包装器很有用，而 CEO 是否每天使用 AI 是采用成功的关键。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为每个人都会拥有至少一个智能体，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying but users bring their own AI; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我坚持智能体需要人类监督，SaaS 并未消亡但用户自带 AI，且基准测试高估了 AI 的自主性。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create value; edge of AI is with real humans.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我重申 AI 不会导致失业末日，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值，AI 的边界在于与真实人类的结合。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的规模扩张轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是充满巨大潜力的新领域，超越编码和数学。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而不是权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；关键在于解决智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 数据，而非算力或制造，是人形机器人最大的约束。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference critical for real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 人形形态支持迁移学习；端侧推理对现实部署至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计，旨在实现 iPhone 式时刻。

brettadcock.en: Human hand is benchmark; robot hand parity fundamental for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 人手是基准；机器人手达到同等水平是通用机器人的基础。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，我认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投入而将持续存在。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; better data yields 10x improvement vs 1-2% from algorithms.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，我强调后训练中数据质量比算法更重要，更好的数据带来 10 倍提升，而算法仅提升 1-2%。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization is a risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，我认为基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练的最大突破，支持推理和工具使用，但存在过度优化的风险。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade, despite lagging 6-9 months behind closed models.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，我坚信开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，尽管它们落后闭源模型 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; compute constraints widen US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律仍然成立，但收益主要来自后训练和推理扩展；算力限制拉大了中美差距。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt process per project.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉，并根据每个项目调整流程。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers spend less time mocking up, more on execution and speed.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师花在制图上的时间减少，更多时间用于执行和速度。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 设计师必须是块状通才或破解的新毕业生；仅凭品味不够。

jennywen.en: North stars are now 3-6 months out; speed and shipping early build trust.
jennywen.zh: 北极星现在只有 3-6 个月远；快速和早期发布建立信任。

jennywen.en: Human judgment and care, not process, drive great design; AI augments but doesn't replace.
jennywen.zh: 人类的判断和关怀，而非流程，驱动优秀设计；AI 增强但不取代。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning; vision is sufficient for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，主张通过下一个词预测扩展 Transformer 会涌现出上下文学习等能力；视觉对驾驶已足够。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but entropy must be preserved; end-to-end learning and distillation can shrink cognitive cores.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，强调合成数据重要但需保持熵；端到端学习与蒸馏可缩小认知核心。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, vibe coding democratizes programming; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，氛围编程普及编程；智能体需十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed, synthetic data collapses, and cognitive cores are tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，认为我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心很小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: I delegate all coding, humans outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability drives automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，进入智能体工程：我委托所有编码，人类可外包思考但非理解；可验证性驱动自动化。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and scales via model disagreement.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：超越训练分布的泛化是关键；好奇心驱动的探索通过模型分歧防止过拟合，并实现可扩展的好奇心。

pathak.en: Curiosity-driven exploration evolves into pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data for robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年到 2026 年：好奇心驱动的探索演变为在多样化数据上预训练、在真实世界数据上后训练的机器人学习范式。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a universal brain can power any robot, but deployment is the primary technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：机器人学是数据问题；通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但部署是首要技术挑战。

pathak.en: Sample efficiency and real-world applicability remain central; sim-to-real and deployment require rigorous engineering.
pathak.zh: 始终：样本效率和真实世界适用性始终是核心；仿真到现实迁移和部署需要严谨的工程。

pathak.en: Contrary to language models, robotics progress is slower; video data alone is insufficient, needing simulation and real data.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：与语言模型不同，机器人进展较慢；仅视频数据不足，需要仿真和真实数据。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在超出训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability; biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 仅强化学习足以实现持续学习；隐藏思维链保持可解释性；最大风险是权力集中。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进展需要由高水平的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 分化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission harm.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全优先需避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

carlpei.en: Survival is the core value; startups must stay alive to achieve their vision.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值观；初创公司必须活下去才能实现愿景。

carlpei.en: AI will commoditize; only a few companies will thrive, and hardware margins are low.
carlpei.zh: AI 将商品化；只有少数公司能繁荣，硬件利润率低。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will be replaced by brain-computer interfaces, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将被脑机接口取代，而非眼镜。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not a hype.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是最快的差异化手段；AI 是成分，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Content creation and marketing arbitrage are key advantages for challenger brands.
carlpei.zh: 内容创作和营销套利是挑战者品牌的关键优势。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns, improving generalization.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前行，提升泛化能力。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; pure end-to-end is superior.
kendall.zh: 混合规则与学习系统往往集两者之短；纯端到端更优。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality trump algorithms.
kendall.zh: 扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；基础设施和数据质量胜过算法。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short term.
kendall.zh: 零样本泛化可覆盖 500+ 城市；短期内消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third option, making the trolley problem theoretical.
kendall.zh: 安全至上；最小风险操作总是提供第三种选择，使电车难题成为理论问题。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表示、推理和个性化。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn. Chat is like MS-DOS; future UI will evolve.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代、每日发布以学习。聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来 UI 将进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富交互产品；推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing evolves; unlimited plans may become unsustainable. Curiosity is key skill to ask good questions.
turley.zh: 定价随技术演变，无限套餐或不可持续。好奇心是提出好问题的关键技能。

nando.en: AI should augment humans like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog by embracing local languages and diverse talent.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全是最大的未解难题，并认为非洲可通过本地语言和多元人才实现跨越式发展。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive, human-centric AI that solves global problems, from climate to education.
nando.zh: 始终倡导包容、以人为本的 AI，用于解决气候、教育等全球性问题，这一主线贯穿其观点。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack real-world experience.
jimfan.zh: 具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 缺乏真实世界经验。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, providing infinite data and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，提供无限数据和安全的探索。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 机器人学的数据瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱房屋——是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 到 2040 年智能机器人将超过 iPhone 数量；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms for designer expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应优先招聘与差异化；品牌指南是设计师表达的动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win; brand narrative attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明设计如何助力公司取胜；品牌叙事吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; avoid structured design crits, prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张速度与决断优于完美；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈；直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy; process adapts to problem, not universal template.
