henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，招聘多元技能与原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权；流程因问题而异，不套模板。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses, but data is proprietary; open alternatives should be pursued.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我强调后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全响应至关重要，但数据是专有的，应寻求开放替代方案；到 2025 年，这一观点深化为对数据瓶颈的强调。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段使用强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，这标志着我从后训练转向预训练阶段的 RL 应用。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can match frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性，并认为使用多样化合成数据的小模型可以媲美前沿模型。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能；微调可能因长上下文和动态计算而过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL likely suffices for AGI by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习在语言模型上无智力上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以在 2027-2028 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; agents' reliability over time horizon matters more than raw capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；智能体的可靠性（按时长衡量的成功率）比原始能力更重要。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30 hours) expands achievements; coding leads.
sholto.zh: 2025 年底，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展成就，编码是最可验证的领域。

sholto.en: Capability overhang exists; managing agent teams and compute supply are key; world models not critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为存在能力过剩，未来在于管理智能体团队和算力供应；世界模型并非 AGI 关键路径。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools from the 90s are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具应互操作，以代码为源头；90 年代的遗留工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副业项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用就像忽视早期互联网。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要的编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为 AI 进步的下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我预测 AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，并需要数十年才能完全展开。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter models, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，Shazeer 认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，扩大算力和数据能让模型更聪明，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term lever; future models need trillion-token context and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年起，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components replaces monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；持续学习与模块化组件将取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone yield AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对推理至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as self-accelerating AI; open-source models narrow the gap with frontier.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他称 AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码作为 AI 自我加速的用途被低估，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD in ML is the best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径；人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved. Post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party oversight is necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散。仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，第三方监管变得必要。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are key for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习对机器人技能获取的重要性，并指出强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，避免硬编码先验知识，并发现语言模型可迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，提出仓储机器人需达到 99.9%的可靠性，并认为单一神经网络可跨任务和末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: Consistently values self-play, imitation learning, and RL for robotics; later adds unsupervised learning and transfer from language models.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视自对弈、模仿学习和强化学习在机器人领域的应用；后期补充了无监督学习及语言模型迁移。

abbeel.en: Shift from focusing on RL limitations to leveraging unsupervised learning and pre-trained models for efficiency and generalization.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 年关注强化学习的局限性，到 2021 年转向利用无监督学习和预训练模型提升效率与泛化能力。
